scientific.integrity: The deterministic scalar specialization of published SOFIM Algorithm 1 is derived directly from its bias-corrected first moment and Sherman–Morrison inverse. The limiting sign-symmetric cycle and its stability are solved exactly; a weighted-norm contraction plus decaying correction establishes actual source-initialized convergence from a nondegenerate parameter interval.
limitations: Deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratic; fixed learning rate and positive Fisher regularization.
The sharp general phase boundary is for sign-symmetric period-two orbits of the limiting autonomous map.
The exact source-initialization attraction theorem covers the explicit parameter and initialization interval only.
No global basin, stochastic dynamics, higher-period census, or decay-schedule theorem is claimed.

title: A sharp attracting-cycle window for regularized-Fisher momentum on strongly convex quadratics
